desc:
👹 Become the King of Curses! Train and unleash devastating slashes, and defeat powerful Cursed Spirits as you evolve into the strongest sorcerer!

🎁 CODES IN THE DISCORD!

🖱️ Click to gain +1 Sukuna Slash!
🔪 Unlock powerful Slashes with devastating effects!
👹 Defeat Cursed Spirits and powerful Bosses!
🏆 Earn Wins and climb the leaderboards!
🥚 Hatch Cursed Eggs to unlock powerful Pets!
🔄 Rebirth to multiply your Slash Power!
⛩️ Unlock new Worlds and conquer stronger enemies!
🔥 Upgrade your abilities and become unstoppable!
👥 Play with friends for +10% Slash Power each!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support future updates!

⛩️ Will you become the ultimate King of Curses?
